exposure: High-intensity focused ultrasound (HIFU) ablation of uterine fibroids
cohort: 189 nulliparous women who received HIFU treatment for uterine fibroids at Chongqing Medical University, China, from January 1, 2010, to January 1, 2015
finding: Nulliparous women who undergo HIFU treatment for uterine fibroids can subsequently have successful pregnancy and delivery safely.
